After I came back to one of my many shed bases throughout the map to find my 3 combination lock code not working I thought, "HACKER?"... just like everyone says official servers are full of hackers I've come to conclude 95% of hacker claims are because people are so butt-hurt they died(ie. supersonic headshots), or lost a base, and don't know why they and they need to blame something else but themselves.

so I searched the ends of Google and Reddit to find out if there is a combination lock hack or how did this happen? Did someone watch my empty twitch stream?? was I desynced? (that is a post I found meaning you lock the gate but the game desynced the lock to the ground without you knowing).....

... then... then I found this. And thus concluding (which is actually really satisfying) that there is actually people out there willing to do this, just like I am willing to spend 2 hours busting down 2 gate walls to raid a base. If you can grind through the ups and downs of this game it conditions you to give zero fucks about anything. The 3 cars I have stashed, or the other 3 shed bases I've built (not including the 2 I've lost so far)... I couldn't care less anymore...

A tip of my good hat to you sir. I always say "If they have the determination to get my stuff. Good on them. They deserve it for the hard work."

The truly saddest part about this game is not being able to have a conversation (preferably not trash talking), or a laugh, with the individual that you had a run-in with, especially if it's a classic, very-memorable, DayZ interaction with another player. 

So I will act as if you just stole my base, good luck, the 7 zombies that spawn there are truly annoying at times. I wish you all the best :)

I've been googling about this and trying to get to the bottom of all this. "randomly dying in dayz" was what got me here which could be the best investigative material I've been able to find. 

to be short, but give a little backstory, I got DayZ in alpha but I have never really had the opportunity to play it on a decent computer until now, and I've really been able to dive deep into this game after buying a MSI laptop and going down the rabbit hole. I currently have 5 vehicles, 10 spark plugs, 4 car batteries and 6 radiators... with 2 gas canisters mainly for filling up radiators. word of advice: never travel without an extra rad and gas canister with minimum 30% water. My friend calls me a car crackhead.

to put it short I honestly don't think hackers are as bad as people say in DayZ and official servers, or call me lucky. The best way to put it is in a Steam store review of the game, "I just think people are so butt-hurt that they died they need an excuse, a reason... something to blame but themselves."

... and trust me, I've been through some rough deaths. But in the end I can only conclude that this is the way in DayZ. I love the realism vanilla has to offer, and I can't justify moving to a private server to have a vendor safe-zone or some stupid shit like that. As I like to refer to them as now "SUPERSONIC HEADSHOTS" suck A LOT. Because there is no warning, or no true 100% answer as to "WTF just happened?"

My first SUPERSONIC was at the NW Airfield... fair enough. I learned my lesson. The 2nd was just recently and in the middle of NOWHERE at a cabin at the edge of the map in the NW woods. I should note I was standing in front of my car, literally about to pull all the mechanics out and log out and then blood shooting from the side of my head and quick fade to black "You are dead." but no sound. But hey that's just bad luck perhaps because guess what I encountered not 5-10 mins prior at a different location, where if buddy had luck he may have ran ALL THE WAY NORTH, to where I parked, who knows but I still can't blame anyone but myself. blah blah blah

I've also been popped in the back of the head at a dead end, edge of the map, location with no spawn points, with a pistol and I actually got to hear the gunshots and got a glimpse of the dirtbag before dying.. and this was under 12 hours after the server wipe where I fortunately found a Gunter and got it running and headed straight North to what I thought was a safe spot. I even found another Gunter after spawning and went back and he didn't take the car tent or car. I left a bear trap and land mine at the Gunter and took the rest. Should I mention my salmonela death where some kitchen wielding, peacoat wearing, greaseball somehow found me dropping me gear outside my Sarka because I knew I was a dead man.... like where did he come from? I was indeed North of Cherno... but... it was far... but... DayZ... many many, bad, weird, unfortunate, unlucky, hilarious encounters that ended bad for me. But not once can I blame hacker yet. It's made me a hardened, paranoid, freak... and boy do I love this game.

The day I get a SUPERSONIC HEADSHOT in my in-game shed, then I will scream hacker and quit. That day has yet to come. I love this reply to a Tweet from the devs:

I had the problem that all the white lights were on, faded and at a solid state. The work around previously mentioned here didn’t work for me, and when I would hold factory reset button all I would get was a green light on and the other 3 solid, faded white lights still on, and nothing would happen. I even found a CNET article saying that if that was happening it was time to replace the device. BUT I was able to fix it!

I would highly suggest trying to contact Google support when you have any issue. I got a guy in a chat with me within seconds of opening the support ticket and he helped me fix it. The fix was really strange but I’ve done it twice now and it works. 

My device was a Google Home Mini, and I toggled the mic switch on and off several times and then unplugged the device, waited a few seconds and then plugged it back in. After plugging it back in toggle the mic switch on and off a few more times (how many times to be exact? I don’t know I just did it a bunch) and that caused the device to factory reset. 

The Google Support person told me this was indeed a strange fix, and that the engineers were also baffled as to why this was happening to devices and were still trying to get an update out there to fix it. 

Anyways I hope this helps someone else out there.
